notes: Entries and Jyutping largely accurate; all dictionary CHECKs are valid colloquial readings. Fixed unnatural phrasing (bus button is 撳鐘, 菜 vs 餸, 長期客), particle/character mismatch 㗎啦→㗎喇, 感冒 mistranslated as flu, risky 姐姐 reading.
